Why this tool

A good routine needs to fit more than your goal.

A saved workout from a video may assume equipment you do not have or more training days than you can manage. Writing your own also means deciding which movements belong together and how much work to schedule.

FuelPhysique's personalized workout builder uses your training preferences to suggest a routine. You can inspect the exercise selection and planned weekly workload before making it your active plan. It is a starting point to review, not a promise of results or a substitute for professional coaching.

From first visit to everyday use

How it works

  1. Describe your training

    Set your goal and experience, then choose gym, calisthenics or hybrid training.

  2. Fit it to your week

    Select available equipment, training days and session length. Add a muscle focus when relevant.

  3. Generate and review

    Sign in when you are ready to generate. Review the exercises, sets, repetitions, rest and effort guidance.

  4. Save and use your plan

    Save a suitable plan to your account, make it active and use it in the workout tracker.

What you can do with it

Equipment-aware planning

Start with what you can actually use instead of adapting a generic equipment list afterward.

A usable session structure

See working sets and rest guidance together, rather than a disconnected list of exercise names.

A view of the whole week

Review planned sets by muscle group to understand how your routine distributes work.

Prefer calisthenics or a mix of training styles?

Choose calisthenics in the same builder and specify the equipment available, such as a pull-up bar or rings. Hybrid planning combines bodyweight and gym training. These are options in one tool, so you do not need a separate account or planner for each style.

Tell the builder about injuries, pain or movement limitations where requested. Generated plans are general fitness suggestions; stop movements that cause pain and seek qualified guidance when needed.

Before you start

Your questions, answered

Can I see the builder before creating an account?

Yes. You can explore the form and enter your preferences as a guest. Signing in is required when you generate; the guest flow preserves your answers so you can continue.

Does it support home workouts?

Yes, choose the training style and equipment you have. Review the suggested exercises to make sure your actual setup can support them safely.

Is the plan generated by AI?

The builder uses AI-assisted planning with the app's exercise catalog and validation. Always review the output; personalization does not make it medical advice.

Can I track the plan afterward?

Save the plan and set it as active, then open the workout tracker to record sessions. The exercise library is also available without an account.

Connect the rest of your routine

Weekly training volume

See where your weekly training sets go.

Look beyond a long exercise list. FuelPhysique summarizes planned weekly work by muscle group, using direct sets and fractional contributions from exercises that involve multiple muscles.

Explore weekly training volume →

Workout tracking

Bring your plan to the session. Keep the record.

Open a session from your active plan, follow the exercises and record completed sets. A built-in rest timer helps you move through the workout; saved history keeps the session available afterward.

Explore workout tracking →

Meal planning

Turn a nutrition goal into meals you can make.

Build a day of meals around your preferences, with ingredient amounts and estimated calories and macros. Swap a meal that does not suit you and keep a plan you want to use.
